prompt: Hyper photorealistic cinematic masterpiece, ultra detailed 8K. A breathtakingly beautiful young woman dragon rider with flowing dark hair and intricate leather armor sits confidently atop an enormous, ancient, terrifying dragon. The dragon is fiercely majestic - massive muscular body covered in glossy jet black and deep crimson obsidian like scales with metallic iridescence, sharp horns, glowing amber eyes, smoke curling from nostrils, powerful wings half folded. The woman grips reinforced reins, posture regal and commanding. They stand on a crumbling stone parapet of a colossal dark medieval gothic castle tower. Below stretches a vast golden hour countryside: lush rolling green hills, patchwork farms with tiny farmers, a picturesque medieval village with thatched roofs and chimney smoke. Dramatic volumetric god rays pierce scattered clouds, contrasting the menacing dragon and castle against the peaceful sunlit landscape. Razor sharp details, cinematic moody lighting, subtle valley mist, photorealistic textures, dark fantasy aesthetic, shot on 70mm IMAX, rule of thirds, awe inspiring grandeur. --chaos 80 --ar 9:16 --raw --profile otarbsx --hd --v 8.1
